__comment_database: On-disk SQLite database used to durably mirror the device cache so it survives a restart. 'path' selects the file (defaults to '.warden.db' next to the service). 'check_same_thread' must stay false so warden's worker-thread pool can share the single connection, and 'timeout'/'busy_timeout_ms' control how long sqlite waits on a locked database.
__comment_device_ttl: Seconds after which an unseen device is pruned from both the cache and database. Defaults to 604800 (1 week).
__comment_job_workers: Background job system: size of the worker-thread pool that runs scan/ARP-poison/sweep jobs off the main service thread. Must be greater than 0.
__comment_job_result_ttl: How long (seconds) a finished job is retained so its status/result can be polled via the API before it is evicted. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour).
__comment_arppoison_default_duration: Default duration (seconds) of an ARP-poison block job when none is requested. An ARP-poison block cuts a single local-network device off the LAN by poisoning its ARP cache (via arpspoof) and black-holing its traffic.
__comment_arppoison_hard_cap: Absolute upper bound (seconds) an ARP-poison block may EVER run, regardless of the requested/default duration. ARP-poison blocks are additionally restricted to targets on warden's own local subnet.
__comment_device_scan_interval: Cadence (seconds) of the routine per-device open-port / OS-detection scans. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour).
